evidence.evidenceSnippet: Vanaf 1 september stelt de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) een eigen AI Chat beschikbaar: UvA AI Chat. De UvA zegt dat deze speciaal is ontwikkeld voor veilig experimenteren met GenAI in het onderwijs en een zelf ontwikkelde GenAI-tool op deze schaal beschikbaar stelt. De tekst zegt dat gedeelde gegevens binnen de technische infrastructuur van de UvA blijven, maar specificeert niet dat de runtime door UvA wordt gehost.

claims.claimText: The University of Amsterdam has a policy framework for Generative AI in education that provides central guidelines for responsible use of GenAI based on scientific integrity, with room for faculties and programmes to translate the policy into their own educational practice.
claims.claimValue: UvA has official GenAI policy framework for education with faculty-level customization

evidence.evidenceSnippet: The policy framework contains general and specific guidelines for the responsible use of GenAI in education. At the same time, it offers faculties and programmes room to translate the policy into their own educational practice. After all, GenAI requires customization: the impact and proper application differs per discipline.

claims.claimText: At the UvA, both the Netherlands Code of Conduct for Research Integrity and the European Code of Conduct for Research Integrity apply, which outline the principles and standards for integrity in research and teaching.
claims.claimValue: UvA adheres to Netherlands and European Codes of Conduct for Research Integrity

evidence.evidenceSnippet: At the UvA, both the Netherlands Code of Conduct for Research Integrity and the European Code of Conduct for Research Integrity apply. These outline the principles and standards for integrity in research and teaching.

claims.claimText: The University of Amsterdam is developing its own AI chat environment called UvA AI Chat, which is similar to ChatGPT but is fully self-managed and specifically designed for UvA students, lecturers and staff.
claims.claimValue: UvA AI Chat is official self-managed AI tool for UvA community

evidence.evidenceSnippet: The UvA is developing its own AI chat environment: the UvA AI Chat. This application is similar to ChatGPT but is fully self-managed and specifically designed for UvA students, lecturers and staff.

claims.claimText: The UvA and VU task force on AI in education has produced criteria for software to ensure academic integrity, and expects students to be transparent about how they have applied generative AI in their own learning and work.
claims.claimValue: UvA requires student transparency on GenAI use and has software criteria for academic integrity

evidence.evidenceSnippet: The UvA and VU draw up clear rules and guidelines on how students may use AI during teaching and assessment. We expect students to be transparent about how they have applied generative AI in their own learning and work.
